description: The Android app's own ssh key, shown in Add a host (it has no ssh agent), and the question it asks about a host's key it hasn't seen (it has no terminal to run ssh in).

messages.heading: This phone's key
messages.none: Make a key for this phone, then put it in each host's ~/.ssh/authorized_keys.
messages.put_line: Put this line in each host's ~/.ssh/authorized_keys.
messages.new_body: Hosts that have the current key need the new one in their authorized_keys.
messages.unreadable: This phone's key couldn't be read: {$why}
messages.no_key_yet: this phone has no key yet: Add Host… makes one
messages.not_trusted_yet: the host's key isn't trusted yet
messages.trust_body: This phone hasn't connected to {$dest} before. Compare its key's fingerprint with the host's own (ssh-keygen -lf on its host key) before you trust it.
